source_body.application_contract: One optional complete authored visual realization. Preserve every named owner, part, count, material, representation layer and directed connection in both languages. Use only inside independently frozen requester meaning and all actual affected dimensions and properties. Sibling alternatives are optional and never automatically combined. Each distinguishing endpoint must be simultaneously visible; hidden, merged, reversed or cropped evidence does not pass the whole case; partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. Research graphs, citations, discovery labels and role tags grant no typed native facts, owner permission or whole-source qualification. A still arrangement alone does not prove motion through time, timing accuracy, measured function, actual material chemistry, historical authenticity, consciousness, consent, ownership, coercion, occupation, identity, intent or supernatural causation.

all_material_decisions.rationale: Source review 0; composition-comparison.md. The source needs fabric tails attached to a hair fastening. Those added hair-accessory effects may change the protected reference hair appearance; a bob alone is not the required fastening. Skip rather than alter that reference property.

Source review 1; composition-comparison.md. The complete source requires an air/underwater split, one waterline and objects continuing across it. A raised reservoir and free stream do not supply an underwater scene or shared crossing object. Introducing a split-waterline set would replace the local workbench viewpoint and obscure the machine/soil relation, rather than clarify it at creativity 1.

Source review 2; composition-comparison.md. The scuba source requires the same diver with secured cylinder, BCD, continuous hose and mouthpiece. No diver or worn breathing equipment exists in the frozen subject; a copper irrigation tube is not a substitute.

Source review 3; composition-comparison.md. Its brass gear and polished plate surface is already realized by baseline phrases broad brass gear, open brass side plate and polished contact patches. No new material contribution is retained; source exposure is not source use.

Source review 4; composition-comparison.md. The source is a wound toy with a linkage to its moving part and an ordinary toy-operation baseline. The declared regulator is not a toy or music-box owner; generic winding does not supply that specific complete source. No toy meaning is imported.

Source review 5; composition-comparison.md. The source requires a community-run watershed station with contemporary workwear and unbranded sensors under its declared landcare context. The image has neither that institutional context nor sensors, and reference appearance cannot establish Indigenous identity or permission. Skip the complete source.

Source review 6; composition-comparison.md. The upper-lip source requires an explicitly contemptuous portrayal. No requester contempt meaning exists; a working gaze is not contempt. Its expression condition is unmet.

Source review 7; composition-comparison.md. This full bundle combines stored mechanical energy with escapement-regulated release, programmed motion/calculation, artisan access/repair evidence and its member requirements. The baseline has a spring and cam but does not supply an escapement, a calculation test frame, repeated-motion verification or a repair handoff. Shared clockwork words are insufficient for whole-bundle adoption. The final generic spring clarification is separately grounded in the independent baseline and source 42, not a partial adoption of this bundle.

Source review 8; composition-comparison.md. The complete pose requires a visible principal planted leg, a differently supported free leg and connected pelvis/torso over that base. The bench portrait leaves those support surfaces outside the lower crop; declaring them from an imagined stance would not realize this source. Expanding to full-body support would reduce the mechanism scale for a benefit outside the current study.

Source review 9; composition-comparison.md. This source requires one text line, an annotation explicitly anchored to that line and differentiated page/tool hands. It would introduce a new semantic text-reference task on a closed text dimension; the watering gaze is not a text-line relation. Alternative L compares the separately returned page-turn source without pretending to adopt this annotation contract.

Source review 10; composition-comparison.md. A continuous source-to-landing liquid path is already literal in the baseline short downstream spout sends one fine continuous stream onto the soil and darkened landing point. No distinct source-driven change is needed; no opt-in visual obligation is selected.

Source review 11; composition-comparison.md. The handoff source requires two distinct permitted human actors, giver hands and receiver hands at opposite edges. The frozen portrait has one woman and no separately authorized/declared receiver; its effects do not authorize adding that person.

Source review 12; composition-comparison.md. Compatible tactile relation realized in complete alternative R. The knuckle tap adds a beat but explains the watering task less directly than a steadying hand; not selected after R/P comparison.

Source review 13; composition-comparison.md. The complete oxygen-access scene needs a worker, a supervisor, a locked cage, its sole visible key and an oxygen-cylinder valve. These owners and the additional actor/count are absent and count/subject expansion is not open. A key and water valve cannot stand in for the complete political-access relation.

Source review 14; composition-comparison.md. Compatible supported page-turn scene realized in complete alternative L with a reading stand and separate hand roles. L adds a quiet autonomous-help interpretation, but P better connects the woman with the water landing; skip after comparison.

Source review 15; composition-comparison.md. Compatible planting activity realized in complete alternative T, with one rice seedling contacting soil and the other hand holding a bundle. P retains a clearer single causal path and more readable apparatus; T is not selected.
